key_insight: Generative AI agents and their harnesses are being used to solve and check research-level mathematics.
engineering_relevance: The notes offer design principles and practical guidance for using and contributing to mathematical proving and verification agents.
method: Examine proving agents Rethlas, Danus, and Pharos and verification agent OSVerify.
Compare each agent with its base model and present case studies.
Explain agent design principles, usage, and contribution workflows.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports base-model comparisons and case studies but provides no quantitative results or evaluation details.
watch_item: Agent-generated proofs still require careful validation; the abstract does not establish verification guarantees.
paper_title: Notes on Generative AI for Mathematical Research
